# Footer software logos

The footer embeds these vectors inline, so its logos work offline and do not require media-CDN uploads or third-party requests. The original downloaded SVGs are retained here without modification; `sources.json` records their source URLs, size and SHA-256.

- DaVinci Resolve, Blender, Unreal Engine, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects and OpenAI: [Simple Icons 11.15.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/11.15.0), CC0. See `LICENSE-simple-icons.md` and `DISCLAIMER-simple-icons.md`.
- Jianying uses the matching CapCut mark: [theSVG CapCut mono asset](https://github.com/glincker/thesvg/blob/main/public/icons/capcut/mono.svg), MIT, copyright (c) 2025 thesvg.org. See `LICENSE-thesvg.txt`.

The marks identify tools used by the portfolio author; they do not indicate sponsorship or affiliation. Brand marks remain the property of their respective owners. Shapes and proportions are preserved; only the presentation uses a shared monochrome color.
